remarks: This spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bath rental offers the comfort and convenience of townhouse living with four levels of versatile space. The compact yet functional kitchen flows into a welcoming living area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Step outside to your private deck and enjoy a quiet morning coffee or evening retreat. With ample storage throughout, this home provides room for everything you need. Ideally located just steps from the Dorothy Hamill Skating Rink, you'll have recreation and neighborhood amenities right at your doorstep. A wonderful place to call home and create lasting memories!
